findings: Both captures describe US Terminal on-receipt tips after card authorization using a confirmed manually captured PaymentIntent. The integration inspects the expanded latest Charge's overcapture_supported, then captures the confirmed amount plus tip. Capture updates PaymentIntent.amount, leaves the original authorization readable via Charge amount_authorized, and triggers no additional authorization.

Both captures retain the eligible US merchant-category and card-network conditions, the greater-of 50% or USD 50 overcapture limit, and the eligible-MCC incremental authorization or separate generated_card PaymentIntent alternatives.

The existing summary describes the general manual-capture flow and both methods of exceeding the overcapture cap. Its API Flow lacks the new mobile SDK default caveat. The linked Terminal tipping concept already documents the iOS and Android 6.0.0 defaults separately and links back to the summary.
conflicts: The mapped guide (wiki/sources/source-stripe-terminal-on-receipt-tipping.md:17) and tipping concept (wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal-tipping.md:70) say the full amount shows only at settlement. Both assigned captures say the full amount appears after capture and no additional authorization causes an immediate statement update. The linked overview (wiki/sources/source-stripe-terminal-collect-tips.md:32) similarly specifies settlement, while its April 27, 2026 companion raw (raw/stripe-terminal-collect-tips-2025.md:43) says the initial pending authorization updates later without giving that exact timing. Preserve the overview route and dated authority while flagging the adjacent mismatch for the coordinator.
